decisions.reason: Setting the level-9 bullet color to green does not change Tab-driven hierarchy creation, indentation, or alignment behavior.
The visual color requirement for a level-9 bullet does not affect alignment of numbered lists at 10 or higher.
The bullet-color change does not alter the required stability of content pasted from legacy templates.
The level-9 bullet color has no necessary effect on pasted-table structure or column containment.
The bullet visual change does not modify manual line-break behavior after pasting.
The complete style-catalog obligation remains unchanged; the missing green bullet is represented by the narrower bullet-design Requirement and must not be duplicated into the catalog state.
The green level-9 bullet requirement does not change style prefixes, naming coverage, conditions, or language.
The same message reports missing theme colors, but that is execution evidence already recorded for this candidate and does not modify its required palette state.
The bullet-color specification does not change the supported Word environment or general reliability constraints.

The caption typography is independently established by another clause of the same message and is already represented by a same-message INTRODUCE Event; the bullet-color modification causes no additional state change.
The level-9 bullet color does not affect Heading 3 font size or weight.
The bullet visual change does not resolve or modify the template's default-language requirement.
